02126 Ziyna' {zee-naw'}

源自 02109; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Zina 1; 1

細拿 = "飽足的"
1) 一位革順的利未人, 示每的次子; 又稱作細撒 [2125] (#代上23:10|)

02126 Ziyna' {zee-naw'}

from 02109;; n pr m

AV - Zina 1; 1

Zina = "well-fed"
1) a Gershonite Levite, second son of Shimei; also called 'Zizah'
